metadata.title: Open vs Closed AI.
metadata.note: Standalone teaching explainer (~2min). Narrator Muskan, @HumanitariansAI, banner 'AI, Explained'. ONE insight: open-weight vs closed-weight = how much of the model you can actually access and control — a trade-off between control and convenience, and open-weight ≠ open-source. Hero visual: black box (closed) vs downloadable model (open). Bookends render (composer/verdict/outro); body B01-B04 are house-style 4K PIL cards.
